description: The U.K. National Institute for Health and Care Excellence (NICE) has recommended dostarlimab with platinum-based chemotherapy, within its marketing authorisation, as an option to treat primary advanced or recurrent endometrial cancer with high microsatellite instability or mismatch repair deficiency in adults when systemic therapy is suitable. Dostarlimab is recommended within its marketing authorisation and subject to the commercial arrangement available to the NHS.
